_README: Copy to configs/<YOURNAME>.json, fill in the values, then add the secret WITHOUT putting it in this file: ./Manage-MrmConfig.ps1 -Action Encrypt -ConfigPath ./configs/<YOURNAME>.json   -- if your host does not show a prompt (ISE, remoting, redirected input), pass it explicitly: $s = Read-Host 'secret' -AsSecureString ; ./Manage-MrmConfig.ps1 -Action Encrypt -ConfigPath ./configs/<YOURNAME>.json -ClientSecret $s
_auth: Pick ONE. Certificate is preferred. For a client secret leave the two certificate fields out entirely and let -Action Encrypt add ClientSecretEncrypted.
_optional: Remove any line you do not need.
